status: Policy design fixed before outer evaluation
design: 2 GP backbones x 3 optimizers; six endpoints, five grouped folds, three policy seeds.
actor: Same GP mean/SD actor architecture selected in the previous benchmark, held fixed within endpoint/fold.
warm_start: One shared 1000-step supervised warm start per endpoint/fold/GP/seed; validation selects among checkpoints, including the GP-greedy initialization.
critic: Same critic forward map for PPO and TRPO. Both detach actor features for critic loss, ensuring critic steps cannot invalidate a TRPO trust region. Historical PPO remains a separate reference.
trpo: Natural-gradient actor update using conjugate-gradient KL Hessian-vector products, damping, and backtracking. Accepted steps require empirical average KL <= target and positive sufficient surrogate improvement.
dpo: Offline trajectory preference adaptation: two frozen-warm rollouts at the same initial hit; prefer fewer purchases until optimum, discard ties. Sum log action probabilities without length normalization. Standard reference-relative logistic DPO loss.
dpo_behavior: Frozen warm policy at temperature1.5 for preference diversity; DPO reference probabilities use its original temperature. Preferences never use validation or test outcomes.
budget: 60 screening or 400 final training iterations, with eight generated rollouts per iteration. DPO caches paired frozen-policy rollouts and executes two minibatch updates per iteration. State-transition counts, optimizer steps, and wall time quantify the respective compute budgets.
policy_selection: Four HP configurations per algorithm/backbone, two finalists per endpoint/fold/arm, validation selects one, repeated at seeds29/47.
metrics: Purchases to any top1/2/3/4. Primary minimum pool size15; include all pools >=3 and larger-cutoff curves.
inference: Paired bootstrap over linked series groups, averaging starts/seeds first. Holm correction over seven primary optimizer/GP contrasts.
gp_auxiliary: Separate GP training with independent random within-series pair likelihood, sampled with total series weight proportional to compound count. Predictor-role training data remain isolated from RL-role training data.
limitations: Exploratory development-fold evaluation with fixed GP seed and inherited architecture. DPO is adapted to acquisition sequences.
